answer_4.quote: We run an AMT crowdsourcing study, where we annotate claims and topics extracted from Debatepedia.
answer_4.guideline: The first question was to select the stance of the claim towards the topic, out of the following choices: in favor, against, neither and I don't know. The second question was whether the claim refers to a consequence related to the topic, with possible answers yes, no and I don't know.
